lifeguard.menu.title: Lifeguard
lifeguard.menu.switch.tooltip:
Left click: next (Auto, On, Off).
Right click: back.

A = Auto, following the profile.
lifeguard.menu.confirm.deep_end.title: Go Off the Deep End?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.deep_end.message: This turns on %s entries, including ones made for Deep End that most players won't want: %s
lifeguard.menu.confirm.dangerous.title: Turn on %s?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.reset.title: Reset overrides?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.reset.message: %s entries switched on or off by hand go back to Auto and follow the profile again. Values like ranges stay as they are.
lifeguard.menu.summary.title: After a restart
lifeguard.menu.summary.subtitle: Your changes are saved. They take effect the next time the game starts.
lifeguard.menu.broken: %s can't be read:, fix it by hand
lifeguard.menu.locked.server: Set by the server you're playing on
lifeguard.menu.locked.broken: %s can't be read, so this can't be changed until it's fixed
lifeguard.taste.none: No taste. A direct extension of someone else's precedent, Lifeguard makes basically no judgement calls.
lifeguard.taste.light: Light taste. Some light calls were needed, but Lifeguard tries to be conservative and follow an existing precedent
lifeguard.taste.strong: Strong/Heavy taste. Lifeguard's own opinionated change.
lifeguard.taste.deep_end: Developed for Deep End. This change was explicitly made to be a part of a specific pack, and probably isn't something most people would want.
lifeguard.taste.dangerous:
Dangerous. Changes to core mechanics with often untested consequences.

ONLY TURN THIS ON IF YOU ARE SURE YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING!
lifeguard.taste.none.name: No taste
lifeguard.taste.light.name: Light
lifeguard.taste.strong.name: Strong
lifeguard.taste.deep_end.name: Deep End
lifeguard.taste.dangerous.name: Dangerous
lifeguard.menu.details.empty: Click an entry to see what it does
lifeguard.menu.details.why.profile_on: On: the profile includes this taste
lifeguard.menu.details.why.profile_off: Off: the profile doesn't reach this taste
lifeguard.menu.details.planned: Planned: declared ahead of its port, no code yet
lifeguard.menu.details.server_note: The server you're playing on sets this
lifeguard.menu.details.broken_note: Its config file can't be read, so this can't change until it's fixed
lifeguard.entry.quark_elytra_duplication: Fixes Quark's Dragon Scales elytra duplication crashing the game when the elytra and the scale sit on a diagonal in the crafting grid. Quark 4.1 sizes the recipe's leftovers for 2 items instead of for the grid.
lifeguard.entry.jukebox.desc: Jukeboxes keep time with the world: everyone nearby hears the same moment of the song.
lifeguard.entry.jukebox.playlists.desc: A jukebox can hold a stack of discs and plays them one after another.
Jukeboxes on the same playlist play it in step, like a station, wherever they are.
A comparator reading a jukebox shows how far through the song it is, instead of which disc is in it.
A player who walks up mid-song hears it from where it actually is, not from the start.
lifeguard.entry.jukebox.speakers.desc: Supplementaries Speakers placed on a jukebox carry its song further.
lifeguard.entry.jukebox.retexture.desc: A new look for the jukebox that shows the disc spinning inside.
lifeguard.entry.tweeter.desc: A Birt-themed wireless redstone block: dyed egg antennas pick the channel, and every Tweeter on a channel sings together.
lifeguard.entry.rune_glints.desc: Quark's colored runes give enchanted gear a glint in their own color, tuned to read in game.
lifeguard.entry.boidsify.desc: Data-driven schooling for any fish: fish that should travel in schools steer together, keep their spacing and avoid walls.
lifeguard.entry.bulb_flicker.desc: Etcetera's light bulbs flicker now and then, like real bulbs on their way out.
lifeguard.entry.bulb_flicker.value.min_s: Shortest wait between flickers, in seconds
lifeguard.entry.bulb_flicker.value.max_s: Longest wait between flickers, in seconds
lifeguard.entry.pause_pauses_music.desc: Opening the pause menu in singleplayer pauses the music too, instead of letting it play on.
lifeguard.entry.paranoid_octopuses.desc: Spawn's octopuses guard the chests they lock, and ink anyone who tries to steal from them.
lifeguard.entry.nerfed_eggnog.desc: Snowy Spirit's eggnog gives a smaller boost, in line with Deep End's other drinks.
lifeguard.entry.brighter_ginger_colors.d: Recolors Snowy Spirit's gingerbread to sit closer to Alex's Caves' candy palette.
lifeguard.entry.lenient_tag_loading.desc: ONLY TURN THIS ON IF YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING. A tag naming something that doesn't exist loads without that entry instead of being thrown away whole. The catch: a broken tag no longer fails loudly.
lifeguard.entry.octopus_nether_chests.de: Paranoid octopuses also lock and guard chests from other mods' Nether structures. Needs Paranoid octopuses.
lifeguard.entry.dye_depot_sparklers.desc: Caverns & Chasms sparklers in Dye Depot's 16 extra colors, and dyeing a sparkler recolors it in place.
lifeguard.entry.plated_bricks.desc: Fills in the plated and chiseled plated bricks Caverns & Chasms has for some metals and not others.
lifeguard.entry.dye_depot_runes.desc: Quark runes in Dye Depot's 16 extra colors, each with its own glint.
lifeguard.entry.easy_anvils_quark_anvils: Makes Easy Anvils' anvil behavior and Quark's anvil changes agree instead of fighting over the same anvil.
lifeguard.entry.candle_holder_soul_flame: Supplementaries candle holders burn with Quark's soul flames when holding a soul candle.
lifeguard.entry.bulb_reload_dark.desc: Fixes Etcetera's light bulbs going dark when their chunk reloads.
Stops Caverns & Chasms storage ducts from chaining across the world and keeping every chunk on the way loaded.
lifeguard.entry.glare_grumpiness.desc: Caverns & Chasms Glares only get grumpy where monsters could actually spawn.
lifeguard.entry.map_atlases_fixes.desc: Fixes Map Atlases exploits and losing maps.
lifeguard.entry.zeta_instance_race.desc: Fixes a rare launch where Quark drops out of Zeta's list of loaded mods (mods load in parallel, and the list wasn't thread-safe). For that whole session Quark's mobs never spawned, Quark missed some of its own loading, and mods looking for it there crashed (Dye the World's creative tab).
lifeguard.entry.quark_donkey_chests.desc: Fixes Quark's chest variants on donkeys, mules and llamas: when one died carrying plain chests in its bags, those turned into a single Quark chest (the rest were lost) and the Quark chest it wore dropped plain. When its drops never came, the next plain chest dropped anywhere was swapped instead.
lifeguard.entry.warden_roar_loop.desc: Fixes a Warden getting stuck roaring over and over.
lifeguard.entry.bucket_mob_flicker.desc: Fixes mobs flickering for a frame as they are let out of a bucket.
